snippet.title: NAMAKORIUM Announce Trailer (English)
snippet.description:
This is the official announcement trailer for NAMAKORIUM.

NAMAKORIUM Steam Page : 
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3866920/NAMAKORIUM/?beta=0

Namako (Sea cucumbers) will save the Earth—NAMAKORIUM is a chaotic, cooperative multiplayer RTS game for up to four players. Command the “cleaners of the sea” —Namako left behind by humanity and work together to clean up the polluted oceans!

Now accepting wishlists on Steam!

Platform: PC
Early Access Relase: January 2026 (Release timing subject to change)
Genre: Multiplayer RTS
Publisher: Polyscape Inc.
Developer: Polyscape Inc.

X Account :
https://x.com/namakorium_en
